angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 547,516 km at 155.36 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.4368 +/- 0.0165 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87): 155.36 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.787 +/- 0.016 solar radii from Palle et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-285 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract): 547,516 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.83 +/- 0.023 solar masses from Palle et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-285 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4975 +/- 95 K from Palle et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-285 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Palle et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-285 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-285.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.565, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-285 (pscomppars): spectral type K2 V, from Palle et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-285 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0 dex, from Palle et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-285 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.42183, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2657374606238804992, flags_flame 00: age_flame 10.101143 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 4.6260014 to 12.453547)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-285 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.9 km/s, from Palle et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
